comments.note: Info — UUID_V4 regex is defined as a local const inside handleOrchestratorStart() (gui/api.ts, line 1600). OWASP A04 (Insecure Design / maintenance). If UUID validation is needed elsewhere in api.ts the pattern would need to be duplicated. Developer and QA already flagged this. Recommendation: promote to a module-level named constant on the next refactor pass.

Info — Shell-injection threat model confirmed safe. OWASP A03 (Injection). The UUID v4 regex uses full anchors (^ and $) and admits only hex digits [0-9a-f] and hyphens at fixed positions, ruling out all shell metacharacters, path separators, and whitespace. Additionally, spawn() is invoked with an array of arguments (not a shell string), so no shell interpolation can occur even in a hypothetical regex-bypass scenario. Double-layer defence-in-depth is correct. No action required.

Info — All OWASP Top 10 categories reviewed. No Critical or High issues identified. resumeThreadId validation is strict (UUID v4, type-checked, fully anchored regex). spawn() array-args invocation eliminates shell injection risk. Test coverage includes non-UUID string, v1-format UUID, empty string, number, valid lowercase UUID, valid uppercase UUID, and omitted field.
